assumptions.execution: next hourly open, adverse slippage; stop first if ambiguous

assumptions.risk: identical risk caps and targets in both arms

outcomes.note: Completed simulated trade outcomes after modeled costs. Virtual snapshot rebalances excluded. Null ratios mean insufficient denominator, not an infinite edge.

findings: Costs were $1099.23 (52% of the net loss); each trade needs ~1.30% to break even.
Before costs, entries still lost $1000.53: entry timing had no edge.
29/41 trades ended on the time exit before target or stop.
Target touched on 0/41 trades; average best move after entry 1.37% vs average target 6.14%.
39/41 entries opened alongside 2+ other markets in the same check; correlated losses.

limitations: Hourly replay cannot reproduce missed five-minute checks, order-book liquidity or exact historical fills.
